sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.7
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The April 16 announcement identifies claude-opus-4-7 and describes agentic, reasoning and vision improvements. Its migration section calls 4.7 a direct upgrade to 4.6, with an updated tokenizer and higher-resolution vision; this is not an explicit size-preserving named-base relationship and supplies no nominal parameter count.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.7 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh 232-page PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 and independently searched in full. Page 10 describes pretraining followed by substantial post-training/fine-tuning but identifies no externally sized base model or nominal total/active count. Parameter mentions concern harness or effort controls. Page 146 residual-stream steering concerns an early version, preserving the original architecture caveat.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.7 model overview
sources.evidence: Reopened with curl October 27, 2026 after web retrieval failed. The exact-model specifications still list API ID, 1M-token context, adaptive thinking, text/image input, text output and April 16 release. Its current-lineup comparison table covers context, output, pricing, thinking, effort and knowledge cutoff; it has no total or activated parameter column.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active Claude models support PDF processing; pages are processed with text and vision. This applies to the active claude-opus-4-7 model identified in s3.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: September 29, 2026 article states generally that Claude weights are not publicly released or customizable and are not provided to users. This is distribution-policy evidence, not Opus 4.7 parameter or architecture evidence.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API service access is governed by Anthropic commercial terms. Sections A and F grant service-use permission while reserving intellectual-property rights, supporting a descriptive proprietary classification alongside the nonpublic-weights policy.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.8 System Card (June 3 revision)
sources.evidence: Fresh complete 246-page June 3 revision retrieved October 27, 2026. Independently inspected training text, full-text count/lineage searches and Table 8.1.A on pages 194–195, which directly compares Opus 4.7 and 4.8 benchmark results. Neither that table nor the searched card supplies nominal total/activated counts for Opus 4.7; the base-model fine-tuning passage concerns Opus 4.8 research variants.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh complete 230-page September 22 card retrieved October 27, 2026. Independently searched for counts and named-base relationships and read Table 8.1.A on page 174. It compares benchmark results for later models, with no total/activated parameter column and no Opus 4.7 size disclosure. Parameter mentions concern effort/harness controls.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 migration guide
sources.evidence: The exact Opus 4.7 migration section confirms adaptive thinking can be enabled or disabled, forced tool choice and the computer_20251124 tool are supported, and the updated tokenizer and high-resolution vision originated with 4.7.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub: Claude Opus 4.7 Summary Table
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and inspected the exact Claude Opus 4.7 summary. It calls the model a hybrid reasoning LLM and describes pretraining followed by post-training, but supplies neither a nominal total/active count nor a sized named base. Product dictation/text-to-speech do not establish intrinsic audio modalities; the original architecture and modality assessments are preserved.

sources.title: When AI builds itself
sources.evidence: Discusses Opus 4.7 research-task results and states generically that current frontier models use Transformer architecture. It does not identify the exact released Opus 4.7 production topology, so that broad statement and benchmark models are not used as exact-variant verification.

sources.title: Models.dev Claude Opus 4.7 record
sources.evidence: Followed the baseline catalog link as a lead; technical conclusions use Anthropic sources instead.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh complete 198-page card retrieved October 27, 2026 and independently searched for model size, parameters and named-base relationships. Table 8.1.A on pages 152–153 reports capability results for Opus 5, Opus 4.8 and peers, with no total/activated parameter column. It does not disclose Opus 4.7 counts or a size-preserving relationship to a sized model.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.7 Deep Dive Research Report
sources.evidence: Fresh numeric lead checked October 27, 2026. The Architecture and Training section labels 400–700B as a scaling-law estimate and says active count is undisclosed; no Anthropic parameter disclosure or reproducible parameter calculation is cited for the range. Its dense-model assertion is likewise unsupported by the reopened Anthropic evidence. Retained only as a rejected secondary lead, not a model specification.

sources.title: Claude Opus 4.7: Release Intelligence, Performance & Price
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved via focused web search October 27, 2026 to resolve the claimed >150B lead. The size-class explanation applies >150B to open-weight models; proprietary models are grouped by price. The model-specific Further details table leaves Parameters blank for both Opus 4.7 variants. It does not support a >150B lower bound or active count.

sources.title: Unmasking the Mind of Claude 4.7 Opus
sources.evidence: Fresh search-index excerpt claims Artificial Analysis classifies Opus 4.7 as >150B, while acknowledging no Anthropic count. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 410. The attributed lead was resolved against Artificial Analysis itself (s15): its open-weight size-class legend does not assign this proprietary model a size.

name.note: Exact developer-published model name and API identifier agree.

developer.note: System card introduction explicitly identifies Anthropic as developer.

family.note: Catalog-normalized family label for the explicitly named Claude Opus model line.

release_date.note: Day is explicit in the launch announcement, original card and model overview; announcement states general availability that day.

open_weights.note: Exact model is distributed through Claude/API services; Anthropic explicitly states its general Claude weights are not publicly released or supplied to users.

license.note: Descriptive service/model licensing classification, not an open-weight license name. Commercial API terms and the explicit nonpublic-weights policy support it.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit found no developer-published nominal total in the original card, current specifications/transparency summary or later 4.8/5/5.5 cards. Pretraining then fine-tuning names no sized base; a direct product upgrade from 4.6 does not establish preserved size. The 400–700B estimate has no first-party support, and the >150B lead misreads a generic open-weight size-class legend. Null reflects missing nominal evidence, not a demand for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked independently of total. Current specifications and later first-party comparison tables provide no activated-parameter column or nominal active count for Opus 4.7. The secondary 400–700B estimate explicitly leaves active parameters undisclosed. No documented dense convention or size-preserving lineage supplies an active value, so none is equated with total.

architecture.note: Exact-model training and interpretability sources reviewed do not establish released production topology. Original-card p146 describes residual-stream steering on an early model; generic Transformer discussion and benchmark architectures are insufficient.

context_window.note: Exact-model overview specifies a 1M-token context window; current documentation, not an endpoint execution test.

modalities.note: Text/image input and text-only model output are explicit; PDF input is supported through the API document interface for all active models. Product dictation/TTS do not add native audio.

reasoning.note: Adaptive thinking is explicitly supported; it can be disabled and is not always enabled.

tool_call.note: Original card identifies agentic tool use; exact-model migration guidance confirms forced tool choice and computer-use tool support.

Anthropic Transparency Hub: Claude Opus 4.7 Summary Table

patch.notes: Nominal total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the reviewed Anthropic specifications and original/later system cards. No sized base-model lineage is documented. Released production architecture remains undisclosed; early-checkpoint residual-stream experiments do not establish it. PDF is an API-supported document input; output is text.

summary: Parameter re-audit on October 27 retains null total and active counts after fresh original-card, current-specification and later 4.8/5/5.5 comparison-table review. Resolved the concrete >150B and 400–700B leads as unsupported by developer specifications; no sized-base lineage was found. Explicit null patches and refreshed evidence added; the other 12 field assessments are preserved.
